Description: Summon forth your interstellar leafkin, and ride it boldly where no leafkin has gone before.
DescriptionEnhanced: This leafkin was a subject in adaptability testing for life-forms native to Etheirys. To the amazement of initiative researchers, the environs of Auxesia appear to highly agree with it, and it not only grew so large as to be able to carry a rider, but developed the ability to fly besides.
Tooltip:
Maybe we should take
a leaf out of their book?
   - Refinery Engineer

Description: Call into action your cosmic armored weapon beta. Further enhanced for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, as its cheery new color scheme would attest.
DescriptionEnhanced: Initiative engineers have modified the cosmic armored weapon, installing two large tanks on its hindquarters and adding the ability to disperse fertilizer over a wide area. In the way it aids the growth of Auxesia's towering trees, it gives the impression of being a beneficial insect.
Tooltip:
A hunter ain't worth shite
without a smithy to keep
him armed and armored.
   - Smithy

Description: Call into action your cosmic predator, another deadly imperial warmachina adapted for use in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative.
DescriptionEnhanced: The predator warmachina, known for its deadliness at close quarters, has been adapted for use in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. Its robust arms, originally designed for destruction, proved equally useful for construction and transportation, and its successful repurposing can be attributed to the ingenuity of Garlean engineers.
Tooltip:
If it bleeds, we can kill it.
   - Ancient Adage

Description: Summon forth your excavating vacuum suit, and live the dream of piloting a futuristic bipedal machina.
DescriptionEnhanced: Created for mining operations in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, the excavating vacuum suit was initially intended to be equipped with a pile bunker. However, this was altered to be a device that harnesses ionic energy on Phaenna, and it ended up going berserk and running amok.
Tooltip:
Had I the components from a standard
magitek excavator, I could begin fitting
them immediately!
   - Justa

Description: Call into action your carbide grey warp loader, and bulldoze your way through life faster.
DescriptionEnhanced: The six-wheeled warp loader, tireless workhorse of the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, has been reimagined in smoldering grey. However, it would be a mistake to assume the color is the only difference, for a cutting-edge ceramic coating has also been applied to the drivetrain, which reduces friction and enhances performance.
Tooltip:
Look at the warp loader go!
   - Cosmic Exploration Initiative Member
